comment_len.name: comment_len
comment_len.value: char_length("comment"."body") <= 750 and ("comment"."deleted_at" is not null or char_length("comment"."body") >= 1)

daily_drop_answer_len.name: daily_drop_answer_len
daily_drop_answer_len.value: char_length("daily_drop_answer"."body") <= 1500 and ("daily_drop_answer"."deleted_at" is not null or char_length("daily_drop_answer"."body") >= 1)

daily_drop_live_has_date.name: daily_drop_live_has_date
daily_drop_live_has_date.value: "daily_drop_question"."status" not in ('scheduled', 'published') or "daily_drop_question"."publish_date" is not null

music_dna_one_subject.name: music_dna_one_subject
music_dna_one_subject.value: ("music_dna_entry"."kind" = 'genre' and "music_dna_entry"."genre_id" is not null and "music_dna_entry"."artist_id" is null) or ("music_dna_entry"."kind" = 'artist' and "music_dna_entry"."artist_id" is not null and "music_dna_entry"."genre_id" is null)
